newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern says rival bid "inferior".
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern says rival bid "inferior".

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said on Wednesday that a rival bid from CSX Corp for Conrail Inc is "inferior."

"The action by CSX and Conrail comes as no surprise," the company said in a statement. "The fact remains that CSX has not provided an overall price comparable to Norfolk Southern's $100-per-share cash offer."
Norfolk Southern, which is expected to raise its $9.1 billion offer for Conrail, said it is reviewing its options.
Under the latest terms, the Conrail-CSX transaction values shares of Conrail at about $8.463 billion, or $93 per share, versus an original value of $8.418 billion, or $92.50 per share.
